description: In stoa-sieve/src/lib.rs::evaluate, Runtime::new() is called on every evaluation. If Runtime construction is expensive (initialization of a sieve-rs runtime), this creates unnecessary overhead for high-volume SMTP filtering where the same script is evaluated against thousands of messages. Runtime should be cached or made static if the sieve-rs API permits it. Impact: depends on sieve-rs Runtime construction cost; not profiled.
title: sieve: stoa-sieve evaluate() creates a new Runtime on every call
